paper.title_en: Distinguishing cosmology, astrophysics and systematics: the Bayesian search for a primordial gravitational-wave background in next-generation observatories
paper.abstract_en: Next-generation gravitational-wave observatories like Cosmic Explorer will provide an unprecedented opportunity to probe the cosmological stochastic gravitational-wave background, providing insight into the early Universe that is inaccessible with other means. We investigate the prospects for measuring a Gaussian cosmological gravitational-wave background in Cosmic Explorer in the presence of a distinguishable, non-Gaussian foreground of binary black hole mergers, using a Bayesian search that simultaneously fits binary black hole and background parameters. We successfully recover a Gaussian cosmological background with a signal-to-noise ratio of 5 in one day of simulated data in Cosmic Explorer without contamination from unresolved signals or data exclusion. However, when introducing waveform systematic errors to our analysis, our inference on the stochastic background parameters becomes biased and can falsely infer the presence of a background when there is none. The bias is driven by signal mismatches at low frequencies (<20 Hz), especially when the recovery waveform is missing physical effects included in the injected signals. While we propose a metric for diagnosing if measurements will be strongly biased by waveform systematics, our results suggest improvements in waveform modeling or other mitigation techniques will be required to accurately recover a primordial stochastic gravitational-wave background in next-generation detectors.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文研究下一代引力波天文台（如 Cosmic Explorer）中随机引力波背景的贝叶斯搜寻，直接评估了区分宇宙学背景、天体物理前景与波形系统误差的能力，属于脉冲星计时阵列/随机引力波背景方向的核心议题。摘要结构清晰，明确给出信噪比结果并诚实报告波形系统误差导致的偏差与局限，方法描述具体（联合拟合双黑洞与背景参数），对研究者有较高参考价值。
decision.title_zh: 区分宇宙学、天体物理与系统误差：下一代天文台中原初引力波背景的贝叶斯搜寻
decision.abstract_zh: 下一代引力波天文台，如 Cosmic Explorer，将为探测宇宙学随机引力波背景提供前所未有的机会，从而提供其他手段无法获得的关于早期宇宙的洞见。我们研究了在 Cosmic Explorer 中，在存在可区分的、非高斯的双黑洞并合前景的情况下，测量高斯宇宙学引力波背景的前景，使用同时拟合双黑洞和背景参数的贝叶斯搜寻。在 Cosmic Explorer 中，我们在一天模拟数据中成功以 5 的信噪比恢复了一个高斯宇宙学背景，且没有来自未分辨信号或数据剔除的污染。然而，当在我们的分析中引入波形系统误差时，我们对随机背景参数的推断会出现偏差，并可能在不存在背景时错误地推断出背景的存在。这种偏差由低频（<20 Hz）处的信号失配驱动，尤其是当恢复波形缺少注入信号中所包含的物理效应时。虽然我们提出了一个度量来诊断测量是否会因波形系统误差而受到强烈偏差，但我们的结果表明，需要在波形建模或其他缓解技术方面进行改进，才能在下一代探测器中准确恢复原初随机引力波背景。
